attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured nofile=8192 / nproc=256 login-session limits via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, implemented as an Ansible playbook (playbook.yml + inventory.ini) run from node2 (control node, has ansible-core 2.20 installed). Since node1 (Ubuntu 16.04, Python 3.5) is incompatible with ansible-core 2.20's Python-module requirements, the playbook uses idempotent `raw` tasks (SSH-only, no target Python dependency) to create the user and write the limits file. Verified via a real SSH login session as appworker that both soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256 are enforced. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baselines, restarted node1 and node2 one at a time via `shutdown -r now`/`reboot`, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified post-restart recovery (user/limits persisted on node1, enforced via live SSH session; ansible-playbook re-run on node2 showed changed=0, confirming idempotent, working control-node tooling).
